paragraphs: There are two lines that Hero could take here. He could bet the flop and check-call blank turns against Villains who float to stab with hands like A-Q, A-J, Q-J, Q-9s, and J-9s. More commonly, he could check intending to call and continue on A, 10 and club turns. | prefer to check-call because it's a lower variance line that requires fewer assumptions.
Hero checks. Villain bets $270. Hero calls.
Check-calling and bet-calling are both reasonable options on this bean Hero is more likely to induce a bet from worse than he is to get called y
